From going viral on India’s Got Latent to navigating the unpredictable world of live comedy, Avinash shares what it’s really like to build a career as a stand-up comic in India.
In this episode, we talk about how he got on India’s Got Latent, the psychology behind performing on stage, why comedians develop a thick skin, and how they deal with audiences that don’t laugh. We also dive into communication coaching, handling nerves before a show, maintaining work-life balance, and whether stand-up comedy is secretly one of the most humiliating professions in the world.
